assets.name: logo
assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction / production mobile-game UI asset. Image 1 is a reference and edit target, approved homepage C of 泡泡小队. Extract/recreate ONLY its stitched plush title logo and attached subtitle plaque on genuinely TRANSPARENT background. Exact logo text 泡泡小队, cream 泡泡, golden 小, pink 队, thick violet felt border with stitches, soft fur and slight 3D extrusion. Subtitle plaque exact text 毛绒伙伴 · 一起出发 with two tiny fabric stars. Wide composition about 1000x440, tightly framed with 4% transparent padding, complete silhouette. Preserve the approved title's friendly letter forms and premium textile style. Remove EVERYTHING else: no animals, no settings, no cloud backdrop, no bubbles (especially no large bubble on the title), no game buttons, no panels except the attached subtitle plaque, no watermarks. This is an actual transparent sprite to place over the live homepage, not a screenshot.

assets.name: background
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit, clean background plate for a layered mobile game. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: approved C homepage. Create a full bleed portrait approximately 1080x2340 clean BACKGROUND ONLY that matches the same soft lavender/lilac plush-cloud world, fine fluffy fur textures and diffused warm lighting. Remove ALL text/logos, animals/flowerpots, buttons, icons, cream bottom dock, UI, and ALL soap bubbles and stars. Reconstruct those spaces naturally. Upper 0–35% is quiet luminous lavender sky with very gentle blurred clouds at extreme corners; middle 35–65% has very low soft cloud cushions with open surfaces where separate character sprites will be placed; lower 65–100% is plush lavender cloud stage/sea with shallow rounded cushions, approximately the 3-tier cloud scene from the reference, naturally fading toward the horizon. No enormous cloud peaks occluding the centre. Side bands at x=0–18% and82–100% especially calm to leave room for future buttons. No scene objects, no decorative bubble highlights, no graphic symbols, no characters or UI. Premium tactile felt/fleece studio scene, restrained contrast, identical lavender palette. This is the actual background texture behind independently animated characters and controls.

assets.name: dock
assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction / UI production asset. Use supplied approved C homepage as style reference. Create ONLY the BLANK cream fabric BOTTOM DOCK surface, with no contents. Wide approx 1080x480 rectangular panel, transparent outside its outline. Shape: broad softly undulating rounded top edge as in the reference, upper corners rounded, sides extend straight downward to flat bottom edge. Fill buttery ivory/cream plush fabric with warm peach shadow near the bottom, subtle fine fabric grain, delicate cream stitched seam following top edge. Very soft restrained shadow underneath. Leave the inner panel completely EMPTY, to place live UI over it. No rabbit, no bubble, no medal, no text, no logo, no stars, no start button, no album button, no border at bottom, no backdrop. Tightly framed with only a small transparent margin at top. It should resemble a continuous bottom sheet entering from below the screen, not an isolated floating modal window. Preserve the original light cream/lavender textile palette.
